copy.curiosityHook: When survival requires dislodging the entire globe from orbit, what hazards await a civilization traveling through deep space?
copy.description: Facing an expanding Sun that threatens extinction within a century, humanity bands together to build colossal planetary thrusters and propel Earth itself across space toward a distant solar system.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and suspenseful sci-fi spectacle with heavy extinction stakes, perfect for engaged group viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Director Frant Gwo delivers grand-scale apocalyptic science fiction, grounding a high-stakes planetary voyage in urgent collective survival and relentless kinetic energy.

allowedMaterial: Journey across space toward a new home light-years away
Underground cities and frozen Earth premise
High-stakes action, drama, and survival pace
excludedMaterial: Jupiter gravitational crisis specifics and outcomes
Late-stage mission sacrifices and character deaths
Resolution of the journey to the new home
Third-act tactical solutions and final outcomes
